dst.text: Orland is a mutated vedalken who watches Pontifex rise to lead the Synod after Janus dies, and Pontifex tries to kill him and orders Glissa's death, testing Marek's loyalty, until Bruenna arrives with Neurok wizards.
Orland then orchestrates a vote returning the Vedalken Empire to a Republic, and Pontifex is stripped of power.
Pontifex kills two of his former Synod council members and leaves swearing vengeance.
